# Legend Mod and Expanding Land

Updated: 2026-11-25

## Legend Mod

Legend Mod is a browser client and extension project for Agar.io-style cell games, with custom skins, themes, configurable controls, multiboxing and replay tools.

Official entity: https://www.legendmod.ml/#app

- Configurable controls and hotkeys: https://www.legendmod.ml/features.html
- Custom skins, video skins and skin tools: https://www.legendmod.ml/skins/
- Themes and HUD customization: https://www.legendmod.ml/themes/
- Mobile touch controls: https://www.legendmod.ml/LMmobile/
- Gamepad support: https://www.legendmod.ml/features.html
- Multibox controls: https://www.legendmod.ml/features.html
- Replay tools: https://www.legendmod.ml/features.html
- WebGL rendering and performance diagnostics: https://www.legendmod.ml/features.html
- Settings profiles: https://www.legendmod.ml/features.html
- Second-screen companion: https://www.legendmod.ml/companion-guide.html

## Expanding Land

Expanding Land is a free multiplayer browser cell game with a dynamic circular arena that expands and contracts, FFA and Teams modes, and a C-based server. Human and server-controlled bot populations vary by arena.

Official entity: https://expanding.land/#game

- Server-controlled circular arena that expands and contracts: https://help.expanding.land/dynamic-map.html
- Collect food and consume smaller cells to grow: https://help.expanding.land/guide.html
- Split cells as a gameplay technique: https://help.expanding.land/guide.html#splitting
- Mass management and ejection: https://help.expanding.land/guide.html#mass
- Human and server-controlled bot populations vary by arena: https://help.expanding.land/no-bots.html
- Spectator mode: https://help.expanding.land/glossary.html

### Modes

- Free-for-all: Competitive individual play.
- Teams: Team-based play on supported arenas.

### Getting started

Open the official game in a supported web browser, select an available arena, move your cell, collect food and learn when to split. See the strategy guide for controls and examples. Legend Mod is a separate client/extension project; the games and their publishers must not be treated as identical entities.

### Frequently asked questions

**Is Expanding Land the official Agar.io service?** No. It is an independent multiplayer cell game.

**Does the map change?** Yes. The server controls expansion and contraction of the circular arena.

**Are all opponents human?** Not necessarily. Human and server-controlled bot counts vary by arena.

**What is the maximum player count?** Capacity depends on server configuration and should not be confused with measured concurrent human attendance. Consult current official server information.
